answer: FINAL CANDIDATE ANSWER: The odds ratio for p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation (gseapy, Reactome_2022) could not be computed in this environment: gseapy was not installed and could not be installed (no PyPI/network access), Enrichr/Reactome endpoints were unreachable (DNS failures for pypi.org, rest.enrichrdb.com, maayanlab.cloud), and no cached Reactome_2022 GMT exists — so gene-set membership was not fabricated and the odds ratio is left undefined. What WAS computed: differential expression between CBD/cisplatin combination treatment (Group 9, Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50, n=3) and DMSO (Group 3, n=3) using a DESeq2-style Python pipeline (median-of-ratios size factors, MOM dispersion shrunk to a parametric mean-dispersion trend, per-gene NB GLM Wald test) yielded 992 statistically differentially expressed genes at raw p<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5, baseMean>10 (549 up / 443 down; 947 unique symbols; 366 genes also at BH padj<0.05) versus a 15,543-symbol background of baseMean>10, symbol-mapped genes. The odds ratio is reconstructible in one step (OR = a*d/(b*c) with a=|DEGs∩set|, b=|background∩set|−a, c=|DEGs|−a, d=|background∖set|−c) the moment a Reactome_2022 gene-set source is available; both required symbol lists are exported as results/background_symbols_baseMean_gt10.txt and results/deg_symbols_p_lt0.05_lfc_gt0.5_baseMean_gt10.txt.
